transactions.desc: Gil (shoulder) was activated from the 7-day injured list at Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Tuesday, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports.
The Rockies recalled Fulford from Triple-A Albuquerque, and the 27-year-old will start behind home plate and bat eighth against the Dodgers on Tuesday.
The Rangers activated Jansen (forearm) from the 60-day injured list Tuesday.
Robinson signed a minor-league contract with Atlanta on Tuesday.
The Royals recalled Duran from Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
The Royals optioned Erceg to Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
The Dodgers recalled Sheehan from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday, Katie Woo of The Athletic reports.
The Blue Jays activated Sosa (wrist) from the 60-day injured list Tuesday and outrighted him to Triple-A Buffalo.
The Yankees reinstated Rodon (elbow) from the 15-day injured list to start Tuesday's game at Baltimore.
The Athletics recalled Rashi from Triple-A Las Vegas on Tuesday.
The Athletics optioned Barnett to Triple-A Las Vegas on Tuesday.
The Pirates optioned Mattson to Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates recalled Kelly from Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Mets reinstated Warren (forearm) from the 15-day injured list Tuesday.
The Mets optioned McDermott to Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday.
The Reds recalled Banfield from Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday, Charlie Goldsmith of Fox 19 Now Cincinnati reports.
The Reds optioned Marte to Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday, Charlie Goldsmith of Fox 19 Now Cincinnati reports.
Atlanta designated Kinley for assignment Tuesday.
Atlanta recalled Smith-Shawver from Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.
The Reds optioned McCambley to Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday.
The Cardinals optioned Mathews to Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
Curvelo was sent outright to Triple-A Round Rock on Monday.
The Blue Jays outrighted Estrada to Triple-A Buffalo on Monday.
Fernandez was recalled from Triple-A Reno ahead of Monday's game against the Red Sox.
The Royals designated Marte for assignment Monday.
The Royals optioned Cuas to Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Royals optioned Rojas to Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Royals recalled Thomas from Triple-A Omaha on Monday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Locklear to Triple-A Reno on Monday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Carrillo to Triple-A Reno on Monday.
